sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: GLM-5.3-Flash, also known as ox-alpha, is Z.ai's new 320B parameter multimodal open model with 18B active parameters. GLM-5.3-Flash outperforms GLM-5.2 across benchmarks and real-world workloads at one-tenth the price, while approaching Claude Opus 4.8 on coding and agentic benchmarks. This article is a WIP.

sources.title: GLM-5.3-Flash Launch — Ox Alpha Was Zhipu (MIT) | explainx.ai Blog
sources.snippet: Z.ai's launch blog is explicit about the strategy: test anonymously on OpenCode and OpenRouter, become "the most popular model of the week," then ship under the GLM brand with open weights. Hunter Alpha and Healer Alpha → MiMo was the same playbook from a different lab. What changes for builders now: Route to z-ai/glm-5.3-flash (or Hugging Face locally) instead of guessing about stealth/ox ...

sources.title: Z.ai Reveals Mystery Model 'Ox Alpha' Was GLM-5.3-Flash, Run on Chinese ...
sources.snippet: The anonymous model Ox Alpha turns out to be Z.ai's GLM-5.3-Flash. Here's how its inference was designed to run on tens of thousands of Chinese-made AI chips, and why the claimed 100 trillion tokens-per-day capacity figure needs context.
